CHOICE: 2

CONFIDENCE: 4

Solution 2 matches the known result. Illingworth's work on minimum-degree stability of H-free graphs (Combinatorica) shows that for 3-chromatic H, δ_χ(H,2) takes only the values {1/3, 2/5, 1/2}. The value 2/5 is the Andrásfai–Erdős–Sós threshold for K_3, and 1/2 is attained by H without a colour-critical edge. Summing gives 37/30.

Solution 1 is wrong. Its claimed values 2/(g+2) for odd girth g are not correct for every odd cycle; for example, K_{n/2,n/2}+e contains C_5, so the C_5 analysis fails, and the set it produces is infinite-looking and inconsistent with the classification. Solution 3 is wrong because it claims δ_χ(C_{2k+1},2)=2/(2k+3) for all k, which is false; the set it derives is infinite and its sum diverges, contrary to the finite known answer.

I'm not certain of the exact recall of the paper's abstract, so confidence is 4 rather than 5.
